review_question: Among patients hospitalized with severe influenza, do convalescent plasma or hyperimmune immunoglobulin products reduce all-cause mortality versus a control product or placebo?

population.description: Adults or children hospitalized with severe influenza

intervention_or_exposure.description: Convalescent plasma or hyperimmune intravenous immunoglobulin

comparator.description: Control plasma, intravenous immunoglobulin, or placebo

targets.comparison: Convalescent plasma or hyperimmune intravenous immunoglobulin plus standard care versus control plasma, intravenous immunoglobulin, or placebo plus standard care
targets.population_or_subgroup: Adults or children hospitalized with severe influenza

timepoint_policy.rule: Capture the source-defined mortality window and retain its duration and analysis population.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Capture source-reported mortality events and denominators for an eligible immune-product versus control contrast; selection is deferred.

integrity_checks: Do not use target-review forest counts or effects.
Do not mix randomised and post-randomisation analysis populations within a study.
Use a documented 0.5 correction only when a 2x2 table has a zero cell.

extraction_notes: Extract counts, denominators, cohort and timepoint only; effect calculation belongs to the calculator.
